optionsPrivacyText.message: Open Scraper runs entirely locally on your device. It does not collect, store, or transmit your scraped data, URLs visited, or search history. All operations are 100% private.

optionsSubtitle.message: Whether it's 10 rows or 10,000, Open Scraper detects tables, handles infinite scrolls, and cleans the data for you. Turn any website into a spreadsheet in seconds - no coding required.

optionsTitle.message: Turn Any Website Into a Spreadsheet In a Second.
